scenes.text: History's most famous greeting might never have been said.
In eighteen seventy-one, journalist Henry Morton Stanley found the missing explorer David Livingstone in Africa.
Stanley claimed he walked up and said, Doctor Livingstone, I presume?
But the pages of Stanley's diary covering the meeting were torn out.
And Livingstone never mentioned the line in his own letters or journal.
Historians think Stanley may have invented it later to sound impressive.
What famous quote do you think was made up?

title: "Dr. Livingstone, I presume?" was probably FAKE 🎩
caption: Stanley's famous 1871 greeting to Livingstone may never have happened: the diary pages covering the meeting were torn out, and Livingstone never mentioned it. Biographer Tim Jeal thinks Stanley made it up. 🎩
